title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started: Total Units
question: At what period does new privately-owned housing units started: total units reach its highest visible peak, and how much lower is the latest value?

gold_answer.long_answer: The highest visible peak occurs in January 1972 at about 2494. The latest visible value is about 1487 in January 2026, which is about 1007 points lower.
